profile.name: Muhammad Aashir Sheraz
profile.headline: C++ developer. Grounded in computer science.
profile.summary: Computer Science student at FAST-NUCES Islamabad, focused on C++, object-oriented programming, and data structures and algorithms.
profile.about:
Most of my university development work has been in C and C++, with a focus on object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and operating system concepts. I enjoy turning those foundations into working applications and games.

I have also explored Unity game development, Python, AWS cloud fundamentals, and parallel and distributed computing. My first internship at MFSYS Technologies introduced me to professional working practices and supervised learning in AI and Python.
profile.availability: Open to internships and early-career software development opportunities
